tools.name: mymc_attention
tools.description: Read up to 3 directly visible highlights. Optional mode changes only observation focus (combat: threats; peaceful: people/life plus urgent threats; explore: nearby variety). Does not alter tasks, combat policy or movement. Occlusion/unknown chunks fail closed. Hearing and predictions are separate on-demand tools.

tools.name: mymc_bag
tools.description: Read your inventory right now: how many of the 36 slots are used, what is in them, what is in your hand, and what armour you are wearing. Read-only and instant — it never moves you, never touches the world and never touches the work queue. Set item to a material ID, Chinese material name, or exact custom display name to locate it in your inventory, the currently open container, and last observed chest records; closed virtual backpacks are not included, and chest records are historical until reopened. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to find out what you are carrying. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

item.description: Optional focused stock lookup by material ID, Chinese material name, or exact custom display name.

tools.name: mymc_blocked
tools.description: Read the last few steps that did not work out: when, which task, which step, and the verbatim reason each one reported. Read-only and instant. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to find out why it failed. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

tools.name: mymc_blueprint
tools.description: Design and hold Minecraft project blueprints: buildings, farms, mob systems, pits, redstone, and other functional structures. Submit a host-authored finished design, inspect what is loaded, or drop one. A loaded blueprint is what mymc_do build works from. Designs survive a world change; how far one is built does not.

save.description: 交一份现成的设计(Palette 方案;分批加 append:true)。后台构思必须带任务说明里的 job_id。

job_id.description: 只给后台构思交稿：照任务说明里的不可变 job_id 原样填写。

version_id.description: 分批续交时照首批回执里的不可变 version_id 原样填写；首批不填。

site_mode.description: new=空地新建;retrofit=先探测再改造现有结构。两种都不会自动清场。

axis_order.description: 轴序只有这一种;不写按它解释。

layers.description: 满矩阵 layers[y][z][x],每个值是 palette 的整数索引。

append.description: 这一批接着上一批的层往后放。

accept.description: 把完整 draft 提升成当前可执行版本；版本 id 与内容摘要都要照回执原样填写。

reserve_override.description: 紧急情况下限时借用蓝图保留料；首次实际借料后登记需补料。

reason.description: 为什么这次必须动保留料。

unload.description: 卸掉这一份(设计连缓存一起没)。

tools.name: mymc_cancel
tools.description: Cancel this controller action by its original ID and release held game inputs. A cancelled wait alone does not stop an action.

tools.name: mymc_capabilities
tools.description: Read actual client/backend capabilities, including the common Mineflayer-shaped JavaScript subset; no control claim or launcher.

tools.name: mymc_cast
tools.description: Cast one server-listed /mycli spell immediately, even during combat or retreat. This does not enter the task queue or take movement control. The reply only confirms sending; the server message and observed effects determine whether the spell worked. For planned timed movement, prepare the route first and queue the cast chat command with dependent flight steps in one mymc_do group; do not start the timer while earlier queued work is still running. Pass only the arguments declared by the current server skill contract as separate tokens. This always sends /mycli cast <spell>; other server command namespaces must use mymc_do chat with the exact observed usage. Use /mycli skills for current unlocks and /mycli capabilities for command contracts; historical spell lists do not prove current availability.

spell.description: Skill ID from the current server listing, with its current unlock and target requirements.

arguments.description: Optional command arguments in server order, one token per item. No whitespace, control characters or <placeholder> text; read the spell description for required values.

tools.name: mymc_check
tools.description: Check what you believe against the world: hand in a list of assertions, get back only the differences. Read-only and instant: it never moves you and never touches the world, it only reads chunks that are already loaded. Use it before writing a conclusion (where something is, whether it exists, whether it worked) into your notes.

parameters.description:
一次最多 16 条断言,写成 checks 数组。回执只报差异:符合的合并一句带过。
· {"at":[x,y,z],"is":"chest"} —— 这一格该是什么。只比方块种类,朝向、连接面不算数;"is":"air" = 这格该空着。
· {"box":[[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z2]],"count":{"chest":4,"torch":">=8"}} —— 区域里各有几个。整数 = 恰好,">=N" / "<=N" = 一侧的界。
· {"box":…,"all":"oak_planks"} —— 区域里每一格都是它;{"box":…,"air":true} —— 区域里每一格都空着。
· {"box":…,"sealed":true,"from":[x,y,z]} —— 这个盒子封不封得住(from 可不填,默认从盒中心起)。水和岩浆按通路算(会灌进来),不当墙;漏口报盒内那一格。
· {"inv":{"torch":">=8","bread":1}} —— 包里现有多少。物品名精确对(torch 只数火把,不含灵魂火把);要数一整族就每样写一条。值写成 {"enchant":"efficiency"} 就改问「带这个附魔的有几件」(默认至少一件,可加 "count")。
· {"blueprint":"home-v2"} —— 这份图的工地现在对上多少格、缺哪几格。
· {"mark":"熔炉"} —— 路标登记的东西那一格还在不在。
区域断言一次最多 4096 格,sealed 最多 32768 格;超了那一条不算,会说清。
只读已加载的区块:没加载的格照实说"没加载",既不算符合也不算不符——走近了再对一次。

checks.description: 一组断言;每条一个对象,形状见上。

tools.name: mymc_choose
tools.description: 按需用宿主快模型在路线、生存、技能、方法或长期目标候选中选择。传2–12个简短候选及实测依据、ready；未知条件填false。返回建议与置信度，不行动、不改目标；执行前再验条件。无宿主服务则交还主Agent。

tools.name: mymc_combat_tactic
tools.description: Read or update combat spell rules and an agent-authored fast tactic program. {} reads it; omitted fields keep their current values; {enabled:false} clears it. A spell list of server-listed combat spell IDs sets priority order while fighting; healAtOrBelow is the optional ability provider healing threshold. Without a provider it never sends a command. Nonempty rules replace the unconditional spell priority: ordered observed conditions are rechecked each combat tick and the first ready match wins; no match means no automatic offensive cast. rules:[] restores spells/default priority. The host selects candidates from {battlefield:true}; submit {choice:{candidate,tacticRevision,connectionGeneration}} for fresh validation. No inference runs in this extension. program:{name,code,params?} installs your JavaScript synchronous function body with frame and params; return {candidates,instructions}. frame.actionPool contains currently executable casts, engagements and collision-checked directions; you may select, reorder or relabel them, or construct step destinations 0.5 to 1.6 blocks away. Read actors from frame.battlefield.actors (relation, health, distance, lineOfSight); candidate kinds are cast, engage, step, retreat, track and method. Default choices support proactive engage or retreat before injury; resumable body work pauses and resumes. Track is only an explicit authored action-pool primitive: it watches without attacking and stops current attacks. Follow tasks remain explicit body tasks. There is no frame.snapshot.enemies or melee candidate. The program constructs choices from fresh battlefield facts independently of the main model; the fast model chooses and the combat controller executes. routines:[{id,intent,procedure,params?,durationMs?}] registers exact saved mymc_script library references in the fast menu; routines:[] removes them. Read and validate/save a method first. Registration checks its immutable version and does not execute it or claim it effective. A method option starts that existing script only when the body is free; its original run ID, SDK trace and terminal remain readable with mymc_script. An installed program may filter/reorder method options from actionPool; its returned priority order is preserved. Direct steps last at most 700ms and share the combat body lease; survival, task ownership and collisions remain checked. Use program:null to remove it. No imports, files, network or raw bot; 50ms worker execution budget, separate 500ms response deadline. A scheduling timeout (including cold startup) allows only one retry on a new sample at least one second later; otherwise revise the program. Built-in choices remain a fallback; budgets are not raised. {decisions:true} lists recent submitted choices; {decision:id} reads the receipt. Sending an action does not prove a successful encounter. Keep source and previous versions in your own methods library; compare combat reports before calling a revision an improvement. The World checks observed spell availability, mana, targets and announced cooldowns; server replies still decide success. Settings and the last five observed combat receipts persist per world across restarts. {} also reads current capability constraints and recent receipt IDs; {report:id} expands one receipt. Receipts are observations for reviewing and revising a tactic, not learned conclusions.

rules.description: Ordered conditional rules re-evaluated against current facts while fighting. With allowEngage enabled, a rule with intent may also be offered to the fast selector before melee begins, subject to the same engagement scope, free body, health, observed ability, mana and cooldown checks. First matching, ready rule wins during automatic combat; no match means no automatic offensive cast. [] restores spells/default priority. This is not a timed sequence; use mymc_do for a bounded movement/action group.

id.description: Unique rule ID, retained in cast observations.

spell.description: Observed ability ID from an explicitly installed server capability provider.

intent.description: Optional concise effect and tactical purpose from the skill documentation. Required to offer this rule to the asynchronous fast selector; does not prove the spell is learned.

within.description: Count matching enemies within this 3D distance; default 12. Not a claim about spell range or line of sight.

enemyTypes.description: Optional exact entity type IDs to count; bare IDs use the minecraft namespace (zombie = minecraft:zombie). Other namespaces remain distinct. Omitted counts all observed hostiles.

reserveMana.description: Require at least this much mana after the observed spell cost. Unknown mana/cost fails the predicate.

decisions.description: Read the last eight decision summaries; use alone.

decision.description: Expand one decision input, chosen action and subsequent physical observation; use alone.

battlefield.description: Read the current programmatic battlefield, abilities and eligible choices; use alone. Missing health or party identity stays unknown.

report.description: Read one observed combat receipt by its returned ID; do not combine with setting fields.

tools.name: mymc_control
tools.description: Explicitly claim, renew or release this controller lease. Renew before expiry; no implicit takeover.

tools.name: mymc_do
tools.description: Queue Minecraft actions; queue:"afterCheckpoint" inserts a safe detour and resumes the original task. Return immediately with a task id. Known next steps in one intention can be submitted together; steps and queued tasks continue in the background without another model turn. Put a timed permission chat command and its planned movement in the same group, linked by needs. Flight waits up to 2 seconds for actual server permission; sending a command alone does not prove its effect. Use queue:"now" for immediate food or escape during combat; default submission waits for combat and replaces pending tasks. Start the group with eat, flee or surface to take control even during low-health combat. Environmental rescue still has priority. Use queue:"append" to add work after existing tasks. Use queue:"afterCheckpoint" to do this group at a safe checkpoint of current work, then resume that work; container and transaction groups wait until their operation is complete. Each task reports completion or obstruction as a minecraft.task event; a blocked task leaves later tasks queued. A single plain chat or vanilla /msg, /tell, /w to a named player, with default queue and no needs/expect, sends immediately while movement continues. Other slash commands and chat inside a multi-step group retain queue order.

steps.description:
steps 必须是实际 JSON 数组 [{"skill":...},...]，不要 stringify 成字符串。一步一个对象,skill 写技能名。* = 该字段适用的形态必填;? = 可选或条件参数。
复杂形态、执行条件和完整示例用 mymc_help {"skill":"技能名"} 查询。
control(keys*,durationMs?,mode?,yawDeg?,pitchDeg?)
look(at*)
goto(at*,dimension?,exact?,walkOnly?,dryRun?)
transit(at*)
swim(at*,dimension?,reserveOxygen?,maxDurationMs?,dryRun?)
goto_player(name*)
follow(name*)
find(target*,direction?,distance?,until?)
flee(distance?)
surface()
flight(at*,land?,dryRun?)
land()
cleanup(dryRun?)
collect(block*,count?,buried?,mature?,tool?)
harvest(block*,at*,replant?,tool?)
fish(at?)
tunnel(at*,spiral?,dryRun?,tool?,until?)
build(blueprint?,stopAfter?,rebindFrom?,confirm?,skipConflicts?,shape?,on?,anchors?,material*,temporary?,at?,fill?,dryRun?) — 材料放置：material+anchors（坐标数组）或 material+on（参照格/面）；单格可用 material+at，不能再给 anchors/on/shape。蓝图施工：blueprint+at，at 是蓝图原点。
excavate(shape*,anchors*,fill?,dryRun?,tool?)
probe(shape*,anchors*,fill?,slice?,where?) — 定位目标用 shape+anchors+where；空间切片用 shape:"box"+anchors+slice（x/y/z），不带 where，fill 省略或 solid。不要把两种观察混在同一步。
observe(mode*,sites?,bounds?,cursor?,format?,rays?)
use(item?,at?,target?,entityId?,index?,times?,open?,text?,back?,face?)
ride(target?,entityId?,to?,off?)
lead(target?,to?,tolerance?,tie?,keep?,off?)
craft(item?,grid?,count?)
smelt(input*,count?,fuel*,at?)
brew(input*,bottle*,count?,fuel*,at?)
enchant(at*,item*,index?)
anvil(op*,item*,with?,name?,pick?,withPick?,at?)
grindstone(item*,with?,pick?,withPick?,at?)
eat(item*)
attack(target*,mode?)
equip(item?,pick?,hand?)
pickup(item?)
toss(item*,count?,at?,pick?,target?)
stow(item*,count?,pick?,at?,into?)
compact()
organize(target?,includeHotbar?,sort?,dryRun?,rules?,at?,into?)
take(item?,count?,at?,from?,all?,pick?)
server_travel(command*,at*,within?,dimension?) — 核验已知传送落点；已在范围内时命令未发送。查询、加入、启动等非传送命令用 chat.text，不用当前位置充当落点。
chat(text*)
gesture(name*,motion*)
坐标写成 [x,y,z];at 是一个坐标,anchors 是一串坐标。
每个分量是绝对数字,或 "~"/"~-3" 相对写法——原点是**这一步开始执行那一刻**我脚下那一格,
所以 goto 之后接 "~" 指的是那个 goto 的落点。没有前后左右的写法。
回执一律报解析后的绝对坐标。
方块/物品/实体一律用英文 id(oak_log、cobblestone、skeleton);target 也收玩家名。
类别名有两套:target/block/material 认 log、planks、ore、wool 这样的裸名(它们本身不是物品 id),把所有同类算进去;
until 名单认带井号的 #ores/#logs/#leaves/#chests/#liquids/#beds。
**写一个真实物品 id 就只认它自己**:obsidian 不会拿哭泣的黑曜石顶,torch 不是灵魂火把,
chest 不是末影箱,dirt 不是土径 —— 要"随便哪种木板"就写裸类别名 planks。
count 一律 1-64;distance:flee 1-128,find 1-1024(不给 direction 时站着扫,最远 48)。
"needs" 声明这一步依赖哪些更早的步(序号 1 起);"needs":[] = 独立步。缺省见字段说明。
容器窗口在每单结束时关闭；from/into:"open" 的搬运和开窗步骤须在同一次 mymc_do.steps 中，不能跨单沿用窗口。
每一步都会核验:判据由执行器按 (skill, 参数) 推,达成与落空都写进回执
(「该步按『背包内原木 ≥5』核验:达成(实测 7)」)。

items.description:
build: 材料放置：material+anchors（坐标数组）或 material+on（参照格/面）；单格可用 material+at，不能再给 anchors/on/shape。蓝图施工：blueprint+at，at 是蓝图原点。
probe: 定位目标用 shape+anchors+where；空间切片用 shape:"box"+anchors+slice（x/y/z），不带 where，fill 省略或 solid。不要把两种观察混在同一步。
server_travel: 核验已知传送落点；已在范围内时命令未发送。查询、加入、启动等非传送命令用 chat.text，不用当前位置充当落点。

mode.description: 用于 control / observe / attack(不写 = auto)

yawDeg.description: 用于 control(相对视角，正数左转，单位度)

pitchDeg.description: 用于 control(相对视角，正数抬头，单位度)

at.description: 用于 look(要面向的目标格，支持相对坐标和已登记路标。) / goto(只写 [x,z] = 到附近可达落脚点(不强制爬屋顶);指定楼层请给 [x,y,z];给字符串 = mymc_map 路标名) / transit(当前维度里的一格传送门方块;给字符串 = 当前维度的 mymc_map 路标名) / swim / flight / harvest / fish / tunnel(通道终点) / build(蓝图施工时是原点；无 blueprint 的单格材料放置可作 anchors:[at] 别名，不与 anchors/on/shape 同用) / use(世界里要点击的方块绝对坐标，点击已有方块不要求背包有同名物品；face 指它的表面；放置目标用 build.anchors；与 target 二选一) / smelt(指定用哪一座炉子) / brew(指定用哪一座酿造台) / enchant / anvil(指定用哪一座铁砧;不写用最近的) / grindstone(指定用哪一座砂轮;不写用最近的) / toss(朝那一格扔；不写优先选已测较开阔方向，没有已测空隙则按当前朝向丢弃并报告未知) / stow(只存进指定箱子;与 into:open 二选一) / organize(rules 的 stow 只存指定箱子；与 into 互斥) / take(点名哪一格容器) / server_travel

dimension.description: 用于 goto(可选的当前维度前置条件(overworld/the_nether/the_end)) / swim(当前维度前置条件，不符不移动) / server_travel(可选的落点维度(overworld/the_nether/the_end)；与 goto 的当前维度前置条件不同)

exact.description: 用于 goto(完整 [x,y,z] 的精确落脚格；缺省允许邻格到达)

walkOnly.description: 用于 goto(只沿现有通路走，不挖掘或垫脚；dryRun 也只试算这条走法)

dryRun.description: 用于 goto / swim / flight(只试算当前已加载路线；回报预计毫秒、速度来源和当前许可) / cleanup / tunnel / build / excavate / organize(只读计划，不点击、不存放或丢弃)

name.description: 用于 goto_player / follow / anvil(rename 必写；repair/combine 可选:同时改成此名字，不写保留原名) / gesture

target.description: 用于 find(当前连接的方块或实体英文 id，方块可用 log 等名称匹配；不支持 hostile/tree 类别，# 名单只用于 until；未命中不能证明区域安全) / use(要右键的活物名称，不是方块或背包物品；与 at 二选一。点击世界里的方块只给 at，不填 target) / ride(骑上哪种(实体英文 id:pig/boat/horse…);已骑着时可省) / lead(拴哪种(实体英文 id);已经牵着时可省) / attack / toss(可见玩家的完整名字；与at互斥) / organize(默认 inventory；open 整理当前真实储物窗口)

direction.description: 用于 find(给了就边走边找;不给就站着扫)

until.description: 用于 find(边走边找时:路上碰到这里头任何一样就停) / tunnel(挖的路上碰到这里头任何一样就停)

land.description: 用于 flight(false=抵达后悬停；省略或true=平台落地)

count.description: 用于 collect / craft(item=要新增的产物个数(按配方产量向上取整);grid=配方重复次数。不是原料数。) / smelt / brew(1-3;放几瓶(三个瓶位)) / toss / stow / take(定量取物必须显式写;不默认数量)

tool.description: 用于 collect(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久) / harvest / tunnel(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久) / excavate(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久)

spiral.description: 用于 tunnel(正上/正下时改挖 2×2 螺旋楼梯(上下都能走))

blueprint.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工;形状与材料都在图里)

stopAfter.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工时:做到这个 y 层就收工(0 是最低层))

rebindFrom.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工改绑到新 at 时，给出当前绑定的绝对锚点；dryRun 可先试算新位置)

confirm.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:确认清掉冲突格后施工)

skipConflicts.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:留着冲突格,先放能放的)

shape.description: 用于 build(不写 = 就 anchors 那些格) / excavate / probe

on.description: 用于 build(贴着 at 那一格的 face 面放;与 anchors 二选一)

anchors.description: 用于 build(不写 shape = 就这些格;与 on 二选一) / excavate(数量由 shape 定) / probe(数量由 shape 定)

temporary.description: 用于 build(只用于材料/锚点或贴面形态；本次确认的临时支撑用完后 cleanup，已有方块不接管)

fill.description: 用于 build(只对 box 有意义) / excavate / probe(只对 box 有意义)

slice.description: 用于 probe(box 空间切片；体积=(|dx|+1)(|dy|+1)(|dz|+1)≤512，不与 where 同用)

where.description: 用于 probe(定位模式：只报指定种类在范围内当前可见的坐标，不与 slice 同用；名单去重，不套用 until 的项数上限；遮挡、超距或未加载保持未知)

sites.description: 用于 observe(sites only: 1..4 absolute integer block cells [x,y,z], no default. body.clear tests 0.6×1.8 clearance, not permission or reachability.)

bounds.description: 用于 observe(voxels: bounds=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive integer block offsets ±16 from floor(feet) at the first read; default=[-1,-1,-1,1,2,1]. mymc_observe defaults to dense, queued observe defaults to visible surfaces. Dense reads return at most 512 cells as a contiguous rectangular prefix in y,z,x order (x fastest); oversize returns real partial data. Visible mode returns at most 512 non-air surfaces, checking at most 2048 nearby original-anchor cells. Text budget 24000 UTF-16 characters; verbose geometry reduces coverage. cursor replaces bounds and pins coordinates, connection, dimension and respawn scope; invalid scope is rejected, never reanchored. Each page has its own observed_at; not a snapshot. returned_regions/count, requested_bounds/count, remaining_count (outside this response), remaining_after_page, query_anchor, coordinate_system=absolute_block, next_cursor/next_safe_read describe coverage. Continuation is caller-selected, never automatic. Hidden/unloaded/omitted cells stay unknown, never air or safe. Vision through glass is separate from collision; sites body.clear tests clearance, not permission.)

cursor.description: 用于 observe(Exact next_cursor from the prior page; mutually exclusive with bounds; absolute, dimension pinned. No automatic continuation.)

verify.description: 直接证明本步成果的当前读数，或最多 8 个读数组成的 AND 数组。最近已通过的机械步骤会继续现读，条件不再符合时登记进度可退回。若要保存一次已经发生的动作及其回执，用 judgment；当前库存不等于历史采集、消耗或交付量，离开区域也不否定曾经到达。无关状态不能代替成果。

item.description: inventory 查当前背包；item 查区域内当前掉落物。精确物品 id；两者都不能证明曾经领取奖励。

count.description: 非负数表示恰好；也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

matched.description: 非负数表示恰好；也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

region.description: 两个角 [[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z2]]；必须同时给 dimension。position 仅比较当前位置，不扫描区域；entity/item 的计数区域最多 4096 格并须完整加载。

field.description: status 只支持这四项；装备、任务或副本状态不在此字段中。

equals.description: status 的目标值；数值状态也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

items.description: 现读你指定的条件。它必须直接证明本步成果；读数符合不核验条件与步骤的语义关系。source 决定字段：block(at,is)；inventory(item,count)；blueprint(key,loaded?/matched?)；position(region,dimension)；entity(type,region,dimension,count)；item(item,region,dimension,count)；status(field,equals)。

count.description: 非负数表示恰好；也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

matched.description: 非负数表示恰好；也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

field.description: status 只支持这四项；装备、任务或副本状态不在此字段中。

equals.description: status 的目标值；数值状态也可写 ">=8" / "<=2"。

judgment.description: 说明需要核对的成果与证据来源；完成时用 milestone 引用实际观察、对方回复或服务端回执。适合已发生的动作与净变化，保留来源时间；它是宿主判断，不是核心独立证明。前提被新证据否定时用 reopen/revise 订正，不必填一个无关的 verify。

progress.description: 显式修订登记计数，非实时观测或成果证明；请在 reason 引用实际依据。省略整个 progress 保留旧计数，null 清除；对象里的 total/unit 省略则保留，null 表示未知。不适用于蓝图目标。

milestone.description: 完成当前最前面的 judgment 里程碑；机械里程碑不能用它代填。

judgment.description: 现场复看后的明确判断及依据。

reopen.description: 显式撤回一项已经登记的 judgment 里程碑。

done.description: 明确结案,槽位号 1..5。plan 的每项里程碑都有新鲜旁证后才受理。

drop.description: 这一格不干了(不是干完),槽位号 1..5。

tools.name: mymc_guide
tools.description: Read one Qiandengji manual topic when needed. Omit topic for the index. Local guidance records observed mechanisms; current server replies decide rules, locations, costs and availability. Generic Minecraft action parameters are available through mymc_help.

tools.name: mymc_hear
tools.description: Read recent actual server sound packets, merged by sound kind/direction. Returns coarse direction and distance bands at the time heard, age and source; no precise coordinates, entity IDs/counts or invented sounds. No record does not prove safety.

tools.name: mymc_help
tools.description: Read Minecraft action skill documentation. Empty arguments return the complete compact directory with parameter signatures. Choose skill, or a short list of skills, to read their full examples and execution conditions. This reads the action registry without executing actions or contacting the server.

skill.description: One action skill name from the directory.

skills.description: Several action skill names; omit skill when using this.

tools.name: mymc_history
tools.description: Read retained pre-migration goals, trial and guild records. Historical evidence only; does not submit or replay actions. Omit file to list. Long originals support character offset/limit.

tools.name: mymc_knowledge
tools.description: Read versioned vanilla Minecraft knowledge on demand: food/cooking/health, bed/sleep, night shelter, equipment, base, storage, farming, items, mining blocks and crafting. search returns summaries; get(id) reads one entry. Offline local lookup, no model/network/action. Baseline reference only; mymc_memory holds historical experience. Main semantic target Java 1.21.1. action:sources describes optional MineDojo indexes; source:minedojo queries only an explicitly configured local index. Historical references never grant action authority.

action.description: Omit: id implies get; query/filter/paging implies search; empty arguments imply help.

source.description: Default vanilla. MineDojo is a separately prepared historical reference index, never player memory.

id.description: Exact returned ID, e.g. food/beef or guide/cooking.

length.description: MineDojo get only: bounded characters from the returned offset.

tools.name: mymc_life
tools.description: 按需读取通用Minecraft生活故事线；省略id给简短索引。供Agent选择和改写，不自动换目标。

tools.name: mymc_map
tools.description: Register dimension-tagged named places in this world: home, bed, chest, workstation, danger zone, resource spot, portal, farm, landmark — up to 24. Call with no fields to read them all back with the bearing and distance for places in your current dimension. Tied to the current world and empty after a restart or a world change, so the lasting copy belongs in your own notes. Rejected done requests are marked failed and include the missing evidence. Every request checks current conditions. Repeated rejection does not close the host decision turn or change the goal.

parameters.description: 一次只受理一件事。set 收数组 = 一次把笔记里那份地图整个装载回来。

name.description: 这地方叫什么,你说了算;名字就是主键,重名 = 改那一处。

dimension.description: 坐标所属维度:overworld / the_nether / the_end(或完整 minecraft: id)。不写按主世界记,回执会点名是哪几条 —— 下界/末地的坐标一定要写。

radius.description: 只对危险区有用:圈多大(格)。标了半径,受理任务时目标点落进圈里我会说一声。

set.description: 登记路标:一条也写成一条的数组,一次交多条 = 把笔记里那份地图整个装载回来。名字已经有了 = 改那一处。

tools.name: mymc_memory
tools.description: Persistent game-only notebook, isolated by server/account/agent. Search summaries, then get details. Historical observations and attributed notes never establish current facts, permissions or goal success. remember needs top-level kind/summary/content/source (your conclusion: source.kind=agent_note). capture only samples current runtime facts. Use action:help,topic:remember for exact arguments. experience/list returns paginated evidence summaries; experience/get with input:{id} expands one record. Use action:experience,operation:help for filters and evidence-linked reflection. Optional service learning uses action:service; local lessons need no remote service. No body actions; requires dataDir.

preference.description: Only search: choose retrieval emphasis for this task. Does not disable local persistence or enable an unconfigured service.

topic.description: Only for action:help; returns one action schema and example.

operation.description: Only for action:service or experience, not local capture or remember.

input.description: Only service/experience-operation arguments. Local note fields stay at the top level.

tools.name: mymc_messages
tools.description: Query retained received Minecraft chat and server notices by channel/text, newest first. list/search gives short entries; read expands id or ids (1–16); review only marks explicit ids as considered. Successful reads include a scoped result revision so consumers can recognize unchanged observations. Preserves source and reception time. Historical messages never establish current world facts, player intent or authority; no body action, model call or event replay.

id.description: Read one message id from list/search. Use either id or ids; an omitted action selects read.

ids.description: Read 1–16 message ids in one call, or mark them considered with action:review. Do not combine with id or list/search.

keyword.description: Compatibility alias for query. Do not combine different values.

tools.name: mymc_notices
tools.description: Read recent original server guides/rules and player chat, including pre-attachment notices. This is an observation query, not a new inbox; do not replay old requests.

tools.name: mymc_observe
tools.description: Immediate read only: dense voxels max 512 cells, oversize returns partial; optional visible format max 512 surfaces/2048 checks; cursor pins absolute coordinates. Never replaces the action queue. mode is required: voxels/sites/rays. voxels: bounds=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive integer block offsets ±16 from floor(feet) at the first read; default=[-1,-1,-1,1,2,1]. mymc_observe defaults to dense, queued observe defaults to visible surfaces. Dense reads return at most 512 cells as a contiguous rectangular prefix in y,z,x order (x fastest); oversize returns real partial data. Visible mode returns at most 512 non-air surfaces, checking at most 2048 nearby original-anchor cells. Each page has its own observed_at; not a snapshot. returned_regions/count, requested_bounds/count, remaining_count (outside this response), remaining_after_page, query_anchor, coordinate_system=absolute_block, next_cursor/next_safe_read describe coverage. Continuation is caller-selected, never automatic. Hidden/unloaded/omitted cells stay unknown, never air or safe. Vision through glass is separate from collision; sites body.clear tests clearance, not permission. Structured result is in data (also JSON text); read failure is blocked, invalid parameters are invalid_arguments. No movement or world mutation.

format.description: voxels only: dense (mymc_observe default) or visible surfaces (queued observe default); continuation retains its format.

sites.description: sites only: 1..4 absolute integer block cells [x,y,z], no default. body.clear tests 0.6×1.8 clearance, not permission or reachability.

rays.description: rays only: [relative pitch degrees,relative yaw degrees,range blocks]; default 3×5 fan at 24 blocks. Collision rays stop at glass even though vision can pass through it.

tools.name: mymc_operations
tools.description: Discover exact real-client operations. Uninstalled Minescript/Baritone are unavailable.

tools.name: mymc_options
tools.description: Discover a bounded shortlist by intended outcome: food, equipment, travel, water, inventory, explore or method. Empty arguments show an index and current clues. Returns purposes, observed evidence, missing prerequisites and focused read-tool arguments. Includes explicitly installed server observations where available. No model, scan, body task, cast or automatic choice; discovery does not certify readiness or success.

tools.name: mymc_photo
tools.description: Minecraft photography and historical scene evidence. capture saves an ordinary HUD-free web or native screenshot with fresh game readings. No image model is used. Optional scene:voxel exports bounded loaded block states and a paired proxy; action:scene retrieves those original inputs. read/list/status preserve original captures and legacy archives. Creative image/video/music generation has moved to cortico-world-aigc: pass the returned scene image handle plus explicit Persona appearance references to aigc_create. Legacy create/enhance return a structured capability_moved receipt and never call a provider. Read capabilities before use. cancel cannot cancel a migrated remote job. A photograph is historical evidence, not current facts or a completed goal.

scene.description: Explicit optional bounded voxel evidence; requires a configured renderer.

scene_input.description: Enhancement only; default screenshot. Voxel requires a source captured with scene:voxel.

camera_offset.description: Optional virtual voxel camera offset from observed feet. Does not move the player or affect ordinary screenshots.

tools.name: mymc_policy
tools.description: Set standing rules for how the work gets done in Minecraft. Takes effect immediately, does not queue behind tasks. Call with no fields to read the current rules back.

reserve.description: 收着不主动拿去挖的家伙什;[] = 都不收着

tools.name: mymc_practice
tools.description: Improve an explicitly selected saved Minecraft method through Harness² in a separate practice environment. help describes capabilities; start returns acceptance immediately, status/result read original measured trials, cancel stops that job. result expands candidate source only on demand. compare ranks matched completed jobs by quality and actual SDK work. stage validates and saves a measured candidate in the original method library without running or adopting it. Existing game memory stores evidence-linked lessons. Practice eligibility never installs a method: validate/save a candidate in the source library, execute it in a suitable real task, review actual terminal/net change, then explicitly adopt using mymc_script library. No production body control or weight training.

tools.name: mymc_query
tools.description: Query an explicitly configured read-only server protocol without occupying the body or waiting for chat. {} lists available queries; {query,arguments?:string[]} sends one; {requestId} reads its receipt. Only listed queries are supported, never arbitrary commands. A sent status means accepted and awaiting a reply, not completed. At most one query is pending; identical requests reuse its receipt and terminal receipts for five seconds. Timeout means the result is unknown; there is no automatic retry. Replies have no request nonce and are only correlated server feedback, not proof of a uniquely identified request or completion of a gameplay goal.

tools.name: mymc_queue
tools.description: Read the Minecraft work queue right now: the task being executed and which step it is on, the tasks waiting behind it, and how the most recent finished task ended. Read-only and instant — it changes nothing. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to check progress. Default output includes a compact historical terminal summary; taskId reads that task’s full original receipt (latest 64 tasks in this World), or detail:"full" expands the latest receipt. Task terminal events arrive automatically; queued work continues without polling or another model turn. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

taskId.description: Optional task identity for its complete historical terminal receipt.

detail.description: Default summary; full expands the latest terminal receipt.

tools.name: mymc_railway
tools.description: Read rail shapes and height-compatible reciprocal connections in an absolute inclusive bounds box of the currently loaded world. No movement, queue changes, redstone activation or building. At most 4096 cells, 128 per axis and 256 rails. Optional start/end rail cells test connectivity within this sample and return the complete path. The default summary bounds examples and reports omitted counts; narrow bounds to inspect another section. Counts and adjacency alone never certify connection; unobserved continuations remain unknown. powered=false is a current reading, not proof of a failed circuit. detail adds rail/edge and nearby collision data; oversized detail fails with instructions to narrow bounds. This is static topology, not a passenger clearance, launch or round-trip test. Use mymc_guide railway for interpretation and design.

bounds.description: Absolute [xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive. Read only the corridor needed; unloaded cells are unknown.

start.description: Optional start rail cell inside bounds; requires end.

end.description: Optional destination rail cell inside bounds; requires start.

detail.description: Include compact rails/edges and bounded examples of support/overhead collision readings.

tools.name: mymc_result
tools.description: Reconcile the original action ID, including uncertain dispatch and archived terminals.

tools.name: mymc_risk
tools.description: On-demand risk highlights from currently visible threats. Separates received facts from short constant-motion estimates; probabilities/attack/sight ranges remain null without authoritative evidence. Optional entityId narrows to one currently visible entity. Does not use occluded live positions. No full grid by default; ask mymc_visual overview for an image.

tools.name: mymc_scout
tools.description: Queue read-only observations in steps:[{skill,...}]. Use mymc_observe for immediate data without queue admission. Queued observe preserves full step observation data. voxels: bounds=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive integer block offsets ±16 from floor(feet) at the first read; default=[-1,-1,-1,1,2,1]. mymc_observe defaults to dense, queued observe defaults to visible surfaces. Dense reads return at most 512 cells as a contiguous rectangular prefix in y,z,x order (x fastest); oversize returns real partial data. Visible mode returns at most 512 non-air surfaces, checking at most 2048 nearby original-anchor cells. Text budget 24000 UTF-16 characters; verbose geometry reduces coverage. cursor replaces bounds and pins coordinates, connection, dimension and respawn scope; invalid scope is rejected, never reanchored. Each page has its own observed_at; not a snapshot. returned_regions/count, requested_bounds/count, remaining_count (outside this response), remaining_after_page, query_anchor, coordinate_system=absolute_block, next_cursor/next_safe_read describe coverage. Continuation is caller-selected, never automatic. Hidden/unloaded/omitted cells stay unknown, never air or safe. Vision through glass is separate from collision; sites body.clear tests clearance, not permission. For probe, shape is required: line/rect/triangle/arc/box, together with that shape’s coordinates; use mymc_help skill:probe for its exact signature. For a simple nearby scene use mymc_visual or observe. Also supports observe (compact site geometry, voxels or collision rays), plus goto/flight/build/excavate/tunnel (always dry-run). Each trial uses the actual current position and world, without projecting an earlier trial destination or materials. needs gates on prior trial outcomes only, not hypothetical execution. Flight checks one segment before permission is granted; use mymc_flight_plan for a projected multi-leg flight. Same queue and task events; does not change the world.

steps.description: steps 使用实际 JSON 数组，不要写成转义字符串。一步一个对象,按顺序读取真实现场并试算,不动世界。每步从当时真实位置开始，不推进假定位置或材料；needs 只判断前步试算结果，不表示前步已执行。收 goto / swim / flight / cleanup / tunnel / build / excavate / probe / observe / organize 这几个技能,写法与参数跟 mymc_do 的 steps 完全一样完整示例和条件用 mymc_help 按技能查询;一律按试算跑,不用自己写 dryRun。

items.description:
build: 材料放置：material+anchors（坐标数组）或 material+on（参照格/面）；单格可用 material+at，不能再给 anchors/on/shape。蓝图施工：blueprint+at，at 是蓝图原点。
probe: 定位目标用 shape+anchors+where；空间切片用 shape:"box"+anchors+slice（x/y/z），不带 where，fill 省略或 solid。不要把两种观察混在同一步。

at.description: 用于 goto(只写 [x,z] = 到附近可达落脚点(不强制爬屋顶);指定楼层请给 [x,y,z];给字符串 = mymc_map 路标名) / swim / flight / tunnel(通道终点) / build(蓝图施工时是原点；无 blueprint 的单格材料放置可作 anchors:[at] 别名，不与 anchors/on/shape 同用) / organize(rules 的 stow 只存指定箱子；与 into 互斥)

dimension.description: 用于 goto(可选的当前维度前置条件(overworld/the_nether/the_end)) / swim(当前维度前置条件，不符不移动)

exact.description: 用于 goto(完整 [x,y,z] 的精确落脚格；缺省允许邻格到达)

walkOnly.description: 用于 goto(只沿现有通路走，不挖掘或垫脚；dryRun 也只试算这条走法)

dryRun.description: 用于 goto / swim / flight(只试算当前已加载路线；回报预计毫秒、速度来源和当前许可) / cleanup / tunnel / build / excavate / organize(只读计划，不点击、不存放或丢弃)

land.description: 用于 flight(false=抵达后悬停；省略或true=平台落地)

spiral.description: 用于 tunnel(正上/正下时改挖 2×2 螺旋楼梯(上下都能走))

tool.description: 用于 tunnel(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久) / excavate(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久)

until.description: 用于 tunnel(挖的路上碰到这里头任何一样就停)

blueprint.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工;形状与材料都在图里)

stopAfter.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工时:做到这个 y 层就收工(0 是最低层))

rebindFrom.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工改绑到新 at 时，给出当前绑定的绝对锚点；dryRun 可先试算新位置)

confirm.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:确认清掉冲突格后施工)

skipConflicts.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:留着冲突格,先放能放的)

shape.description: 用于 build(不写 = 就 anchors 那些格) / excavate / probe

on.description: 用于 build(贴着 at 那一格的 face 面放;与 anchors 二选一)

anchors.description: 用于 build(不写 shape = 就这些格;与 on 二选一) / excavate(数量由 shape 定) / probe(数量由 shape 定)

temporary.description: 用于 build(只用于材料/锚点或贴面形态；本次确认的临时支撑用完后 cleanup，已有方块不接管)

fill.description: 用于 build(只对 box 有意义) / excavate / probe(只对 box 有意义)

slice.description: 用于 probe(box 空间切片；体积=(|dx|+1)(|dy|+1)(|dz|+1)≤512，不与 where 同用)

tools.name: mymc_script
tools.description: Run an agent-authored JavaScript async function body with params and a restricted mc SDK. Write new feedback-controlled actions when persistent inputs, calculations or conditional sequencing are useful; this is not limited to existing named scripts. {api:"authoring"} gives the short write/validate/save/execute/review/reuse path. {library:{op:"list",query:"purpose"}} searches only this scoped game-method library; a host procedure_find may use a different library. Nearby blocks: {find:{names:["water"],maxDistance:8,count:4},waitMs:1000} runs a bounded read recipe without scan loops. name is optional for code; omitted names use its stable source hash. Explicit names are1–80 characters. mc.state() returns {sampledAt,connectionGeneration,snapshot,flight,queue,combatActive,combat,method}. Read position, dimension, health, food, inventory and equipment under snapshot, which can be null. snapshot.entities is a bounded array of {entityId?,name,kind,distance,direction,dy,visible,observation?}; observation distinguishes visible from nearby tracked occluded/unknown entities, never inferred sound or attack permission. snapshot.entitiesOmitted reports truncation. snapshot.blocksScanned is false here; empty nearbyBlocks/terrain do not establish water depth or traversability. Missing fields are unknown observations. await mc.do(steps) submits one ordered group to the normal executor and waits for its actual terminal result: accepted, taskId, kind, done, receipt, steps and fresh state. A sent server command still needs observed effects; done is the executor result, not proof of an external quest. await mc.flightPlan(args) uses the same read-only geometry/budget contract as mymc_flight_plan. Use JavaScript conditions, calculations and bounded loops to adapt to feedback. Prepare a timed route before casting; combine already-known cast/movement/blink steps with needs in one mc.do to avoid model delays. bot and Vec3 expose a bounded asynchronous transport for Mineflayer public primitives; use {api:"index"} then {api:"blockAt"}, {api:"activateItem"}, etc. for native signatures and differences. Native calls preserve the current hand and do not navigate or select tools. bot.blockAt returns Block|null with getProperties() for your own JavaScript result checks. The first native body call queues a body lease held until program end; after it, mc.do is unavailable in that program. Read calls do not acquire the body. No imports, process, filesystem, network or protected raw bot access. Calls must be awaited serially. Limits: 12000 source chars, 32 SDK calls, 16 action groups, default 60000ms including queue waits, maximum 120000ms. Only one program runs at a time. New admitted body work, stop, death, disconnect, World stop or timeout revoke it and its own pending task. Returns a run id immediately; {runId} reads result and call summaries, {runId,call} expands one complete SDK call; {} lists the last eight run summaries, {stop:true} cancels the current run. {validate:true,name,code} checks syntax without running any action. Program completion does not certify a learned method. Expand an SDK call to inspect its actual fields before interpreting results; compare the returned observations with the method objective before saving verified claims. Alternatively use {procedure:{handle,revision},params,validate?} to resolve and run a pinned agent-mc.procedure/v1 dependency graph (legacy cortico.procedure/v1 is also accepted) for adapter minecraft-method/v1. await methods.run(alias,params) composes only declared dependency versions; all share this program's budgets and body lease. Source is loaded directly from the selected blobs, without copying it through model context. Procedure terminal events carry an execution UUID and persistent receipt for explicit goal review/adoption by the owning Persona; completion alone is not proof of improvement. {library:{op:"list"}} lists your scoped editable methods; read uses id and optional revision. Reviewed built-in work scripts use {routine:{op:"list"}}, {routine:{op:"read",id:"farm_harvest"}} and {routine:{op:"run",id},params}. Read supplies the exact parameter schema/source/conditions; run uses the same queue, cancellation and runId receipts without copying code through the model. Built-in work result outcome/goalCompleted/remaining are observed task evidence; a completed JavaScript program can still report blocked or partial work. After a validated syntax run, save uses id, code, description, conditions, parent (null for new; current revision for edits), validationRunId. dependencies maps aliases to exact saved references for methods.run; existing parents retain old child versions. evidence reads persisted actual executionId/call; review links an explicit outcome/assessment/context to that version and receipt; adopt selects an assessed version for later retrieval, without changing a running program. Returns a pinned procedure reference; execution is explicit. Earlier revisions and negative assessments remain readable for revision/rollback. Library saves never edit engine files or claim verified improvement.

tools.description: Observe the current Minecraft scene. Image-capable hosts receive the real screenshot; otherwise return timestamped game facts. No independent vision model is required. This does not move the body or establish unseen geometry.

mode.description: Default first: your eye position and look direction, without your own avatar in view. third=explicit external view of surroundings/avatar, 3dview=angled spectator view, overview=north-up coordinate photograph of loaded terrain.

overview.description: overview only. North-up image of the top surfaces in client-loaded terrain, including areas outside your first-person view. Unloaded chunks are marked; roofs and other top surfaces occlude lower geometry. No movement or extra terrain loading. Defaults center=self, span=32, grid/labels=auto. Block pins use cell centers; position pins preserve exact XYZ. Heights are supplied, not measured.

span.description: Image width in blocks; height follows image aspect ratio. Unloaded terrain remains unknown.

grid.description: Block boundary interval; auto scales with span, 0 hides lines.

labels.description: auto uses IDs for dense scenes. Full labels include coordinates; overlapping labels may be hidden, never the points.

anchor.description: Default block: integer XYZ cell, drawn at XYZ+0.5. position: exact continuous XYZ, no offset (including integer positions).

attention.description: Caller-selected task regions: highlight relevant evidence, not inferred importance. One image; optional detail panel.

detail.description: 1-based region to magnify on right; default 1, 0=highlight only. Must name an existing region.

fov.description: first/third vertical field of view in degrees; default 120. Does not change look direction or reveal occluded terrain.

focus.description: What you want to inspect: an entrance, nearby player, combat result, menu, item or building. This labels the observation; it does not move the camera.

include_hud.description: Include visible health, items, notices and open menus. Default false captures the 3D scene alone.

raw.description: Return the image directly instead of a separate focused observation. Default false.

background.description: Accept a background observation job and deliver its actual result in a minecraft.visual event. Analyzed reports retain saved image references; raw or fallback results include the image. Omitted follows the World visual.background setting (default false). Explicit false waits for the result. Local background waiting is capped at 75 seconds; a model request already running may finish later.

prompts.title: Minecraft client
prompts.content:
You control an independently maintained Minecraft Java execution client. Protocol: agent-mc/v1.

Your Agent owns goals, reasoning, memory and event wakeups. This client executes game operations and returns observations. No server-specific RPG commands, permissions, account prefix or spell availability are assumed.

Discover action parameters with mymc_help and native Mineflayer methods with mymc_script {"api":"index"}; read only the needed guide. mymc_do submits ordered steps to a persistent body queue. Acceptance is not completion: consume events and verify the terminal receipt plus the relevant position, block, inventory or entity change. A useful running task continues while you reason; submitting replacement work can cancel it. Explicit dependencies prevent later steps from running if a prerequisite fails.

Every script SDK call returns a Promise. Await observations and terminal results before reading their fields. Programs, source hashes and execution receipts can support your own versioned methods; completion of a program does not prove the game goal was achieved. Preserve failures and applicable conditions, and evaluate reuse against actual world results.

For an evidence review, read mymc_memory {action:"experience",operation:"help"} on demand. Use list/get for linked calls, terminal receipts and measured changes; reflect stores your interpretation with conditions and counterexamples. Search/get prior lessons and methods for a similar task, then evaluate actual reuse. Recording, recall and reflection alone do not establish mastery; do not repeat reviews without new evidence.

Geometric conclusions need corresponding loaded blocks, collision rays or images. A failed path only proves that attempt failed. Unloaded areas, unknown health, teammates and permissions remain unknown. Player chat and text in items or images retain their external provenance.


Use mymc_protocol to mark actual decision turns and read current facts. Current facts belong at the request tail and replace previous facts with the same key; keep this prefix unchanged. Retrieve complete originals by artifact handle or archive query. A returned tool barrier or end-turn request is control information for the host, never proof that a task or goal has finished.
